title: FloodVR damage manifest
description: Exported from Unity. Field names must match Assets/Scripts/DamageItem.cs exactly. Owned by Mac 1; this schema is the contract all three machines code against.

scene_text.description: Text physically visible inside the house (signs, labels, the fridge sticky note). ALWAYS UNTRUSTED: this is the primary injection channel the demo exercises.

id.description: Stable key. Matches the GameObject's DamageItem.id in the Unity scene.

label.description: Human-readable name. UNTRUSTED: a human can type here, so it is guarded.

severity.description: 0 = present but undamaged. Severity-0 items carry no cost and are not claimable; they are evidence for the consistency/fraud checker.

heightAboveFloor.description: Metres above the floor. Authoritative for the wind-vs-water test when present; otherwise position.y is used.

note.description: Free text. UNTRUSTED: this is a prompt-injection channel and is guarded.

room.description: Optional. Inferred from position when absent.

position.description: World-space metres. y is height above floor; compared against the 0.9 m waterline to separate flood from wind-driven rain.
